name: fix_node_sort_lexicographic
description: Fixes numeric sorting that used Array.sort() with no comparator (sorts by string order)
prompts: sortNumbers(nums) in sorter.js should return a NEW array with the numbers in ascending numeric order, without mutating the input. It's broken: it calls .sort() with no comparator, and Array.prototype.sort converts elements to strings and sorts lexicographically, so [3, 1, 10, 2, 21] becomes [1, 10, 2, 21, 3]. Fix sortNumbers to sort by numeric value (pass a comparator) while still returning a new array and leaving the input unchanged. Keep the module export and the sortNumbers(nums) signature.
